title: JBuddies Studio On-Ear Kids Wired Type-C Headphones Pink
text:
JBuddies Studio On-Ear Kids Wired Type-C Headphones Pink.
JLab JBuddies Studio are on-ear wired headphones designed for kids ages 6 and up. Built around a volume-limiting design that caps playback at 85dB to protect developing hearing during long listening sessions. Foldable, lightweight, and compatible with USB-C devices including newer iPads, Android phones, and Chromebooks - with the included USB-C to 3.5mm dongle also allowing connection to any standard 3.5mm headphone jack. The 40mm driver delivers full stereo sound across a 20Hz-20kHz frequency range. Cloud Foam ear cushions keep ears comfortable during extended wear. A stainless steel adjustable headband fits a wide range of head sizes. The foldable design compacts for easy storage in a bag or backpack. The tangle-resistant braided nylon cord has an inline mic and track controls - kids can answer calls, skip tracks, and adjust volume without touching the connected device. Connects via USB-C with the included 3.5mm dongle providing compatibility with standard headphone jacks when needed. Includes JBuddies Studio headphones, USB-C to 3.5mm dongle, and a JLab lifetime limited warranty. title: JBuddies Pop Wireless Kids Headphones Pink
text:
JBuddies Pop Wireless Kids Headphones Pink.
JLab JBuddies Pop Wireless are kids' wireless headphones built with parental safety controls at the center of the design. A hearing protection switch lets you cap output at 85 dB or 95 dB, with 95 dB as the default and 85 dB available as a lower-volume safe mode for younger ears or longer listening sessions. Volume limiting holds output at a safe maximum regardless of source device volume, so kids cannot accidentally blast audio too loud even if the connected device is turned all the way up. Wireless Share Mode lets two JBuddies headphones connect to the same audio source, so two kids can listen to the same content without splitting a cable or needing two devices. The 40mm dynamic driver delivers full-range sound from a kid-sized headphone. Bluetooth 5.2 with SBC and AAC MPEG-2 codecs, plus a wired 3.5mm option for when Bluetooth isn't available or the battery runs low. Support protocols: HSP/HFP/A2DP/AVRCP. Battery life sits at 50 total hours of playtime with 25 hours of talk time, and over 600 hours of standby. Charges via USB-C in 3 hours. A single condenser microphone supports calls and voice assistant use. Foldable design for easy storage in a backpack. Button controls are simple enough for kids to operate independently. Includes JBuddies Pop Wireless headphones, USB-C to C charging cable, and a JLab 2-year limited warranty. text:

title: Go Lux ANC Wireless Headphones Sage
text:
Go Lux ANC Wireless Headphones Sage.
JLab GO Lux ANC in Sage are over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation, the starting point in the JLab headphone range designed to deliver reliable ANC performance without overcomplicating things. They sit below the JBuds Lux ANC and bring hybrid ANC, Spatial Audio, Multipoint, and 70 total hours of playtime at an accessible price point. Hybrid ANC reduces ambient noise by up to 30dB using both feedforward and feedback microphones working together. Five MEMS microphones with 3-mic ENC handle both noise cancellation and call clarity. Be Aware Mode switches off ANC and lets in surrounding sound when you need to stay alert. Spatial Audio creates a wider, more immersive soundstage. EQ3 Sound gives you three preset listening modes: Signature, Bass Boost, and Balanced. Battery life sits at 70 total hours with ANC off (40 hours with ANC on) and 40 hours of talk time, with standby exceeding 400 hours. Quick charge gives you 7 hours of playback from 10 minutes of charging. Charges via USB-C in 2.5 hours. Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC codecs. Both Google Fast Pair and Microsoft Swift Pair supported for instant pairing on Android and Windows devices. Multipoint connects to two devices simultaneously. Support protocols: HSP/HFP/A2DP/AVRCP. Compatible with iOS and Android, including Siri and Google Assistant. Movie Mode latency under 200ms for synced video. Wireless Share Mode lets two JLab headphones connect to the same audio source simultaneously - useful for travel or shared listening without splitting a cable or needing two devices. Faux leather ear cushions for a soft, comfortable seal during extended listening. Foldable design for easy packing and storage. Button controls for playback and calls. The JLab app adds custom EQ, control remapping, Music and Movie modes, noise control settings, OTA firmware updates, safe hearing tools, and My JLab device management. Includes GO Lux ANC headphones and a JLab 2-year limited warranty. title: JBuds Lux ANC Jelle Headphones Fir Sure
text:
JBuds Lux ANC Jelle Headphones Fir Sure.
The JBuds Lux ANC Jelle Headphones are part of the Jelle Collection, JLab's first fashion-forward product line, developed in collaboration with Orly, one of the most iconic names in nail polish. Five shimmer shades, each one designed to coordinate directly with a matching Orly nail polish shade, so the color is as intentional as the sound. This Fir Sure finish is an earthy green shimmer, fresh and unexpected, paired with an earthy green shimmer Orly nail polish as its mani match. Hybrid ANC uses both exterior and interior microphones to reduce ambient noise by up to 35dB. Switch to Be Aware mode to let the world back in without taking the headphones off. Lab Spatial Audio shapes the 40mm driver's output into a three-dimensional soundstage that wraps around the listener, paired with Hybrid ANC for a more immersive listening experience. Form-fit earcups are shaped to the natural outline of the ear, padded with 1 inch Cloud Foam cushions. Adjustable hinges and a foldable, lightweight design support all-day wear. Five condenser microphones with 3-mic ENC pick up voice while reducing background sound on calls. The headphones connect over Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC and AAC codec support and a 30+ foot range, supporting the HSP, HFP, A2DP, and AVRCP protocols. A USB-C cable also supports wired charging and wired audio playback. Google Fast Pair speeds up initial setup on Android devices. Bluetooth multipoint keeps the headphones connected to two devices at once, and Wireless Share Mode lets two pairs of JBuds Lux ANC headphones share audio from one device simultaneously. The JLab App unlocks custom EQ, ANC and Be Aware toggling, custom touch controls, and safe hearing limits. Choose from JLab Signature, Balanced, and Bass Boost EQ presets, or dial in a custom setting. The headphones weigh 235 grams and measure 7.47 inches tall, 6.13 inches long, and 3.23 inches wide. Battery life is rated at 70 hours with ANC off or 40 hours with ANC on, with talk time rated at 40 hours. A 2.5 hour charge time and a quick charge option add 7.5 hours of playtime from a 10 minute charge. Standby time is rated at 500+ hours. Includes: JBuds Lux ANC Headset, a USB-C charging and audio cable, and a JLab 2 year limited warranty. title: Epic Lux Lab Edition ANC Over-Ear Headphones Cloud
text:
Epic Lux Lab Edition ANC Over-Ear Headphones Cloud.
JLab Epic Lux Lab Edition ANC Over-Ear Headphones in Cloud are the flagship over-ear product in the JLab lineup, sitting above the Epic tier as the premium Lab Edition product. Built for listeners who want the best audio performance JLab offers in an over-ear form factor, with industry-leading battery life and a complete travel-ready accessory set. The 32mm dynamic driver extends frequency response to 40kHz for Hi-Res Audio reproduction, well beyond standard range. LDAC codec support enables significantly more audio data than standard Bluetooth for compatible Android devices. Spatial Audio includes head tracking, adjusting the soundstage in real time as you move your head for a more immersive, theater-like effect on supported content. Adaptive ANC continuously adjusts noise cancellation based on your environment rather than applying a fixed level. Six condenser microphones with 4-mic ENC handle both ambient noise sampling for ANC and call clarity. Be Aware Mode lets in ambient sound when needed. Auto Play/Pause detects when you remove the headphones and pauses automatically. Battery life sits at 90 total hours with ANC off (60 hours with ANC on), with 45 hours of talk time and standby exceeding 600 hours. Quick charge gives you 5 hours of playback from just 5 minutes of charging. The headphones support both wireless charging and wired charging via USB-C, and rest directly on the included charging dock at home for effortless top-ups between uses. Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC, AAC MPEG-4, and LDAC codecs. Both Google Fast Pair and Microsoft Swift Pair are supported for instant pairing on Android and Windows devices. Multipoint connects to two devices simultaneously. Support protocols: HSP/HFP/A2DP/AVRCP. Wired playback is also supported for when you want a cable connection. Compatible with iOS and Android, including Siri and Google Assistant. PU faux leather ear cushions provide a soft, durable seal for extended wearing comfort. Touch, swipe, and physical button controls give you multiple ways to manage playback and calls. Movie Mode latency under 200ms for synced video. The JLab app adds custom EQ, control remapping, Music and Movie modes, noise control, OTA firmware updates, safe hearing tools, and My JLab device management. A dedicated carry case is included for travel, separate from the at-home charging dock, so the headphones are protected on the go and ready to charge at home without switching accessories. Includes Epic Lux headphones, charging dock, USB-C cable, carry case, and a JLab 2-year limited warranty.
